body:
Findings from the 0.2.5 review that the other fix tasks don't cover. This task goes last because it moves tests out of files those tasks change.

### Tests inside runtime files
AGENTS.md asks for tests in separate files, as `lockdown/paths_tests.rs` does. Move the inline test modules out of `test_tools.rs`, `system_reviews.rs`, `review_schedules.rs` and solace-app's `preferences.rs`. Move the tests added in 0.2.5 to the inline modules in `lockdown.rs`, `migrate.rs`, `workspace.rs` and `drafts.rs` as well.

### Untested branches
AGENTS.md asks for every logical branch to be tested. Add tests for these:
- the schedule's time calculation at the two daylight-saving changes: a time skipped when clocks go forward, and a time repeated when they go back;
- the plan panel's Alt-key and missing-body branches.

(The other untested branches from the review are covered by task:fce41cf13cdbc11e, task:7b0b397f32b8047c and task:b168f0218db19782.)

### Tests that can't fail
- `board_acceptance.py` (around line 825): the human's note and the gate file are written before the agent calls `task wait`, so the wait finds the note at once and the time-limit branch the test is named for never runs. Make the test reach that branch, so it fails if the branch is deleted.
- `sysreview_test.gleam` (around line 385): the check accepts the text both escaped and unescaped. Make it check the escaped form only.

### Spelling
- In `board::tests.a_bad_task_proposal_is_refused_before_asking`, change the unknown field `colour` to `color`.

### Done when
Each item above is done and every test passes.
title: tests: follow the project's test rules
